1339-3967-7920.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3967-7920.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

4247-5571-6922--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
4247-5571-6922--6.description:
Use Coveted Falcon to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7825.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bifur.
When Bifur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Bifur enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
3967-6972-7825.notes: If you have an enduring story, Bifur will trigger twice, and the other counter can be placed on whatever creature you desire.

1621-2146-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

486-1978-7704.description:
Cause Doc Samson to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Doc Samson.
Repeat from step 2.

1833-5708-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
1833-5708-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Stormbound Geist.
Stormbound Geist dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Vein Ripper
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Stormbound Geist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Stormbound Geist, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

877-4753-6967.description:
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Honest Rutstein.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Clever Impersonator triggers, returning Honest Rutstein from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Honest Rutstein by paying {0} due to Morophon and Clever Impersonator.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Honest Rutstein triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7160.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Arcbound Whelp.
When Arcbound Whelp dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Whelp's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Whelp from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

261-3197-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-3197-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

539-2034-2783-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Nesting Dragon triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

413-586-3168-5258-5618.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger, adding {B}{B}{B} and untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

997-3384-4550-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
997-3384-4550-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

850-1029-5028.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
850-1029-5028.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Overgrown Battlement.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
850-1029-5028.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

813-1170-2196-2701.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {U}.
813-1170-2196-2701.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Frantic Search from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Repeat.

4881-5011-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cavalier of Night.
When Cavalier of Night dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Activated Sleeper.
When Activated Sleeper dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, it triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

1322-3259-3973-4214.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four permanents of any color on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature you control except Rith.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-3973-4214.description:
Deal combat damage using Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Rith and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Rith trigger, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least four 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Saproling token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and deal combat damage using Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Rith and Breath of Fury.
Holding priority, activate Utopia Mycon's second ability three times by sacrificing three Saprolings, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

277-880-3678.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
277-880-3678.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1003-2034-3856-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, choose not to pay for the trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ruxa, adding {C}{C}.
When Ruxa dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Ruxa from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ruxa enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2092-4717-4954.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 7 or greater.
2092-4717-4954.description:
Activate City of Traitors by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping City of Traitors and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and if you control lands that can produce {R} and {G}, use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

1636-2178-2263-4050-4536.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Goldberry.
Goldberry does not have summoning sickness.
Goldberry and Geralf's Mindcrusher do not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1636-2178-2263-4050-4536.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher, adding {U}.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its undying ability and Goldberry trigger.
Resolve the Geralf's Mindcrusher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm triggers.
Resolve the Geralf's Mindcrusher trigger, causing a player to mill five cards.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Goldberry's first ability by tapping it, moving the +1/+1 counter from Geralf's Mindcrusher onto Goldberry.
Resolve the Goldberry trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Activate Goldberry's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, moving the +1/+1 counter from Goldberry onto any permanent except Geralf's Mindcrusher, and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1651-2751-3946-5228.notablePrerequisites: Descent into Avernus has at least two descent counters on it.
1651-2751-3946-5228.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Glacial Chasm and Descent into Avernus each trigger.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Descent into Avernus' ability.
Resolve the copy of Descent into Avernus' ability, putting two descent counters on it, then causing each player to create a number of Treasure tokens equal to the number of descent counters on it, and then deal that much damage to each opponent.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat from step 2.

57-1402-2178-2773.notablePrerequisites:
Feldon of the Third Path does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon of the Third Path.
57-1402-2178-2773.description:
Activate Feldon of the Third Path by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Diamond Lion with haste.
Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing damage equal to Diamond Lion's power to any target.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, discarding your hand, and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Thornbite Staff triggers, untapping Feldon of the Third Path.
Repeat.

1978-4306-5089.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least three.
1978-4306-5089.description:
Animate Nyx Lotus using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {3}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

4475-4843.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block Virtus this turn.
4475-4843.description:
Attack the opponent with Virtus.
At end of turn, Reflection triggers.
